records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2022, we generated $767.1 million in total revenue, with a revenue mix of: cloud subscriptions 23%; software license 3%; maintenance 19%; services revenue 51%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: By comparison, in 2016, cloud subscriptions and software license revenue represented 7% and 93%, respectively, of our total cloud and software license revenue mix.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $238.4 million, $196.4 million and $178.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2022, 2021 and 2020, respectively, which represents approximately 31%, 30% and 30% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2022, 2021 and 2020, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our R&D expenses for the years ended December 31, 2022, 2021 and 2020 were $111.9 million, $97.6 million, and $84.3 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For 2022, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $179.6 million and have generated a cumulative total of $505.7 million for the three years ended December 31, 2022.
